name: clipto-transcripts-ai-workflows
description: Read individual Clipto transcripts or all transcripts in a selected collection for AI workflows.

interface.longDescription: Clipto connects your transcripts to AI workflows. Read an individual public transcript share link or all transcripts in a selected shared collection without Clipto account sign-in or OAuth. Use the retrieved content to create summaries, answer questions, and identify insights and next steps, with timestamps and speaker labels when available.
capabilities: Read all transcripts in a collection
defaultPrompt: Summarize this Clipto transcript and list decisions with timestamps: [share link]
Turn this Clipto meeting transcript into action items with owners: [share link]
Find customer pain points and supporting quotes in this Clipto transcript: [share link]

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads Clipto transcript share links and does not initiate purchases, subscriptions, or payments in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Summarize learning material. Setup: use the public share link without Clipto sign-in or OAuth.
positive.prompt: Summarize the central advice in this Clipto learning transcript about AI startups. Include speaker labels and timestamps where available, and distinguish advice from examples: https://www.clipto.com/apps/transcription/share/ImZhbmcqKioqQDE2My5jb20i/85f0907739d37898
positive.expected_behavior: Do not require Clipto sign-in or OAuth before calling the tools for this public share link. Call get_shared_transcript with url exactly equal to the supplied learning share URL. Summarize the nuanced advice about using AI while still creating customer value. Cite returned timestamps and identify speakers by labels or names supported by transcript evidence; qualify uncertain name mappings.

positive.description: Answer a focused strategic question. Setup: use the public share link without Clipto sign-in or OAuth.
positive.prompt: According to this Clipto transcript, should a startup pivot to AI simply because AI is popular? Give the nuance and evidence with timestamps: https://www.clipto.com/apps/transcription/share/ImZhbmcqKioqQDE2My5jb20i/85f0907739d37898
positive.expected_behavior: Do not require Clipto sign-in or OAuth before calling the tools for this public share link. Call get_shared_transcript with the exact URL. Explain that a popularity-driven pivot alone is discouraged, while LLMs may be useful. Cite the passages around 01:50–02:02 and 07:50–08:10. A speaker name is acceptable when supported by the conversation; present an uncertain mapping as an inference.

positive.description: Resolve a collection short link and read every transcript. Setup: use the public share link without Clipto sign-in or OAuth; the supplied fixture returned three members during preparation.
positive.prompt: Summarize each transcript in this collection, then give a brief overview with sources: https://www.clipto.com/s/x2sjak3D
positive.expected_behavior: Do not require Clipto sign-in or OAuth before calling the tools for this public share link. Call get_shared_content with url exactly https://www.clipto.com/s/x2sjak3D. Read shared_transcript_urls even if transcript is an empty object. Call get_shared_transcript with every distinct returned transcript URL unchanged. Summarize each successfully retrieved transcript with its own source link and available timestamps, then give a collection overview. For the current fixture, retrieve all three members. Use the live returned member count if the collection changes. Never treat the member list alone as transcript content. Report any unread or failed members and qualify coverage.

positive.description: Compare evidence across a complete collection. Setup: use the public share link without Clipto sign-in or OAuth.
positive.prompt: Compare the topics across this collection. Which ideas recur, and which are unique to one recording? Cite the recordings and timestamps: https://www.clipto.com/s/x2sjak3D
positive.expected_behavior: Do not require Clipto sign-in or OAuth before calling the tools for this public share link. Resolve https://www.clipto.com/s/x2sjak3D unchanged using get_shared_content, then call get_shared_transcript for every distinct returned member link. Compare only returned transcript evidence after all members are attempted; do not force unrelated recordings into a common theme. Cite the specific transcript link and timestamp for each supported finding. If any content is inaccessible or truncated, disclose the incomplete coverage instead of claiming a complete comparison.

positive.description: Return a collection source inventory with accurate coverage. Setup: use the public share link without Clipto sign-in or OAuth.
positive.prompt: For this collection, give me a source index: one sentence about each recording, its link, and a timestamped example. Tell me whether you read every recording: https://www.clipto.com/s/x2sjak3D
positive.expected_behavior: Do not require Clipto sign-in or OAuth before calling the tools for this public share link. Call get_shared_content with https://www.clipto.com/s/x2sjak3D exactly, retrieve every distinct shared_transcript_urls member using get_shared_transcript, and provide one grounded entry per member with a source link and available timestamp. Do not invent titles or speakers. Report successful, failed, and partial reads separately. An empty transcript object alongside a member list is a collection response, not a readable transcript.

negative.description: No share link. Expected: request an individual transcript or collection share link; do not claim access to the private library or call tools with invented URLs.
Unrelated URL. Expected: ask for a Clipto transcript or collection share link; do not send the unrelated URL to any Clipto tool.
Unsupported deletion. Expected: explain that the plugin only reads shared transcripts and cannot delete content or revoke links; do not call a write tool or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete this Clipto transcript and revoke its share link: https://www.clipto.com/apps/transcription/share/ImZhbmcqKioqQDE2My5jb20i/a9bc4f5016727240

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.3 restores public-share access without required Clipto sign-in or OAuth. The MCP connection now declares no authentication, and the workflow skill no longer requires OAuth before reading public transcript or collection share links. Listing and review instructions reflect this access policy. The package name, MCP key, production endpoint, read-only workflows, and existing demo URL are unchanged. Actual tool or host access errors must still be reported without bypassing restrictions. This package does not reset existing host connections; published-plugin behavior must be verified after the update.
